thesis.title: A Framework for Evaluating the Real-World Performance of Turkish Large Language Models
thesis.author: Atahan Uz

items.name: TurkEval framework
items.desc: Open-source, API-based harness; every run pinned by a reproducible Run Hash.

items.name: Prompting style
items.desc: How prompt language, format, few-shot, CoT and output format move scores.

items.name: Quantization
items.desc: Accuracy across FP8, INT8, INT4, AWQ, GPTQ and NVFP4, sampling held fixed.

items.name: Hyperparameters
items.desc: Temperature, top-k, top-p and repetition-penalty grid, closed vs. open tasks.

items.name: Human validation
items.desc: Native annotators grade outputs; agreement with automatic and LLM-judge scores.

items.name: TR–EN translation
items.desc: Both directions; regular, formatted and long text; BLEU/COMET plus human review.

items.name: Instruction following
items.desc: IFEval-Turkish: 1,041 prompts, strict and morphology-aware verification.

items.name: YKS
items.desc: Models take all of YKS 2018–2026 (TYT + AYT), ranked against real candidates.

items.name: Multi-turn conversation
items.desc: Turkish MultiChallenge: retention, memory, versioned editing, self-coherence.

items.name: Long context
items.desc: NIAH-Turkish: needle retrieval up to 256K tokens, plus a multi-needle variant.

items.name: Q&A with context
items.desc: RAG-style answers from retrieved chunks; grounded accuracy vs. hallucination.

items.name: Translation
items.desc: Paper on the English–Turkish translation benchmark.

items.name: YKS
items.desc: Paper on LLM performance in the YKS university entrance exam.
